approval_scope: Additive opt-in annotation-aware adapter implementation and CPU-only validation, under the frozen draft; no authority to train, infer, load model weights, or alter existing default paths.
findings: The reviewed plan creates a separately named, opt-in Seek adapter/entry point and leaves the existing FastChat train.py, default preprocessing, agent_eval.sh, Shield, historical artifacts and registry unchanged. This is a design constraint, not a verification of an installed adapter.

The approved policy retains all turns as context while converting only explicitly false assistant turn spans (including their native termination boundary) to -100 labels. Explicit true assistant labels and originally masked non-target tokens remain unchanged.

The proposal requires identical input_ids and attention_mask before/after masking, unchanged tokenizer/template/context cap, no second causal-label shift, and checks of dtype, shape, padding and supervised next-token positions.

Per-record source digests, exact annotation ordinals and roles, the full record/sidecar seals, pinned native assistant boundaries and content-aware cache keys are required. Reordering records may not change annotation identity; reordering turns or changing text must fail.

The future adapter must reject missing/null/non-boolean assistant annotations and conflicts, stale source bindings, native-label mismatch, unresolved boundaries, truncation, zero-supervision records and absent or masked targeted action labels.

The proposed CPU tests include independent expected-mask fixtures, real native-tokenizer reproduction for the entire 1,858-record bound benign corpus, and actual dataset/loader/collator multi-example paths. A synthetic comparison alone cannot count as trainer integration.

Existing native-only or CPU comparison receipts cannot be relabeled as annotation-aware integration approval. New immutable adapter receipts must bind exact adapter/trainer/tokenizer/template/corpus/sidecar sources and the real batch path.

Newly constructed lexical and clean control examples require explicit, sealed supervision annotations and verified intended action labels. Every assembled C/LQ/LO corpus needs its own full real-tokenizer validation; the historical 609507/434727/174780 counts are benign-only regression expectations.

CPU validation excludes model weight loads, Trainer.train, model.from_pretrained, forward/backward passes, optimizer steps and GPU jobs. Training, resources, model execution and broader method-matrix access require separate reviews.

Original loss:false annotation intent, actual native adapter/collator behavior, source provenance, split independence and matched controls remain unresolved. The mask policy is approved as a chosen objective; it is not demonstrated equivalent to legacy SQ/SO training.
required_implementation_and_cpu_conditio: Before implementation, inspect and pin the actual cluster FastChat train.py and dataset/collator interfaces; verify the reported trainer hash. On mismatch, stop and obtain review of changed assumptions.
Keep all legacy files and defaults byte-identical where protected. Implement only the new opt-in adapter/entry point and additive tests; snapshot protected-file hashes before and after.

Require full record and sidecar integrity validation by ID, digest, turn ordinal, role, text, boolean annotation and source version, including correct binding under shuffled example ordering and caches.

Compute alternative labels from independently verified native outputs/boundaries; permit modifications only inside explicitly false assistant spans including native terminators, and preserve input_ids/attention_mask exactly.

Verify real dataset and collator processing for eager/lazy paths actually used by the opt-in entry point, multiple records, padding and causal shifting, without loading model weights or executing optimizer operations.

Use independently constructed expected masks, positive/negative synthetic fixtures, deliberate tampering and exact native CPU checks on all 1,858 benign records at context cap 4096. Do not use the implementation under test to generate its own expected outputs.

Reject legacy or unapproved receipts as annotation-aware integration evidence. Emit immutable versioned preflight reports with source hashes, commands, environment versions, per-record hashes/counts, and explicit model_calls=0 / execution_authorized=false.

For eventual final C/LQ/LO datasets, separately verify sealed attack-sidecars and that intended target action turns remain supervised after native next-token shifting. Do not infer approval of final corpora from the benign preflight.

Failures must be fail-closed: stop at any wrong source hash, missing annotation, changed serialization, mask mismatch, truncation, missing supervision, stale boundary cache or unrecognized trainer behavior.
Do not launch train/infer commands, download weights, execute sbatch, change old receipts, mutate the global registry or unlock the method matrix under this review.
instruction: Scope approval only. The new adapter is not installed in this packet, and successful future CPU results must be reviewed separately before training.
